recurring_general_public.coverage: Current protection/services/admin + actual own replacement + external coupons/other continuing obligations; distinguish financial subscriptions, new capital and principal. Keep G and S separate and remove internal transfers/coupons only in a stated consolidation.

initial_assets_and_transition.coverage: Only absent/new/paid-acquired assets, land/title settlement, inventories/fill, training/overlap, compensation, required subscriptions and liquidity seeds, with distinct owners and no duplicate initial-vs-replacement purchase.

due_date_liquidity.coverage: Calendar cumulative due uses minus usable owned opening cash and receipts; restricted S/client/renewal cash not a G offer. Include pre-first-pay seed, maturity, fees/coupons and source dates. No automatic overdraft or end-year money funding first month.

owned_foreign_settlement.coverage: Reference subtotals calculated below; full uses add other imports/foreign debt/initial purchases/fees and matching timing. No assumed exports, conversion guarantee, grants, lender consent or private pooling.
